stemMd: A sector of a circle has radius 6 cm and central angle 120°. What is its area?
explanationMd: The sector is 120/360 = one third of the circle. Full circle area is π × 6² = 36π, so the sector area is 12π cm². Area is proportional to central angle for a fixed radius.

distractorRationale.b: This uses an incorrect fraction or confuses arc length with area.
distractorRationale.e: This treats the angle as a half-circle.
distractorRationale.c: This is the area of the full circle.
distractorRationale.a: This is the numerical arc length 4π cm, not the sector area 12π cm².
